# IElement

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Interface for all renderable PDF elements

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Methods

- [`getChildren`](#getchildren): Canonical child traversal for engine tree walks (the default-style cascade, font/image discovery).
- [`getPreferredWidth`](#getpreferredwidth): Gets the preferred width of this element, if any.
- [`measureHeight`](#measureheight): Measures the height of this element given the available width
- [`render`](#render): Renders this element to the PDF context

### `getChildren`

```typescript

```

Canonical child traversal for engine tree walks (the default-style cascade, font/image discovery). Container elements return their direct renderable children; leaf elements omit it. Optional so existing custom IElement implementations remain source-compatible.

### `getPreferredWidth`

```typescript
getPreferredWidth(): number
```

Gets the preferred width of this element, if any. This is used for auto-sizing in horizontal layouts.

### `measureHeight`

```typescript
measureHeight(availableWidth: number): number
```

Measures the height of this element given the available width

### `render`

```typescript
render(ctx: RenderContext, width: number): void
```

Renders this element to the PDF context
